text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон conquers the Arima Kinen.
Alas, the
audience only has eyes for the
Beast—Narita
Brian's run was simply
incredible.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон's won the race, but lost
the
one-on-one. She vows to get a
proper rematch
with Нарита Брайан at the
Arima Kinen next year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After talking it over, we decide to set
the Osaka
Hai for our next goal, and it's
going to be first
place or bust!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
